newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold prices end down on rising arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold prices end down on rising arrivals.

text.p: Indian gold prices ended lower on Thursday, after a weak opening, on the back of poor world trends, dealers said.
Gold was down by 30 rupees per 10 grammes on Wednesday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) settled 200 rupees lower at 57,100 rupees, after easing by 300 rupees on Wednesday.
"The rise in the premium for special licence to import precious metals from 11.50 percent to 12.50/13.00 percent failed to cheer up market sentiment," he said.
Silver prices opened lower following weak overseas trends but fresh industrial buying and thin supplies trimmed early losses towards the close. Silver was down by 70 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
